engine: Saisei's overlay menu — two panels of OPPOSITE colour slide in from opposite edges to a centre seam: a CREAM nav panel from the LEFT and a DARK identity/contact panel from the RIGHT, meeting at the middle (a 50/50 split). The colour pairing carries meaning: cream = navigation, dark = identity. Nav rows + identity fade up after the panels land. Harvested from D_saisei (S7; menu open v2 f035-048).

measured_teardown.move: open() slides .dpm-left (cream) translateX(-100%->0) and .dpm-right (dark) translateX(100%->0) simultaneously to a centre seam; an optional scrim fades the outgoing page back; the nav rows + identity fade-up (translateY 10->0 + opacity) after the panels land, staggered. close() reverses.
measured_teardown.cited: Saisei menu open: cream from left + dark from right slide to centre (f039 cream sliver -> f046 both meet) = 50/50 split; nav rows + 木 + contact fade up f046-048.

split.what: seam position (0.5 = 50/50; e.g. 0.55 = wider cream nav).

contentDelay.what: delay before nav rows/identity fade up (after panels land).

scrim.what: optional page-recede scrim selector (faded in under the menu).

entry: DualPanelMenu.create(target, opts) -> { open(), close(), toggle(), isOpen(), destroy }. target = .dpm-root with .dpm-left (cream nav, .dpm-item rows) + .dpm-right (dark identity/contact, .dpm-item). The engine sizes the panels from `split`, slides them to the seam, fades the rows up, and reverses on close.
law: transform(translateX) + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL; reduced-motion -> instant open/close. GSAP optional (built-in inOut tween fallback; the _from* helper fields are filtered out of the gsap call). owns_pin false. The colour pairing is the meaning: cream = nav, dark = identity.
gate_mode: triggered overlay (not scroll) — the wheel gate doesn't apply. Verify the panels slide to a centre seam, the rows fade up, and close reverses, smoothly.
